verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a fully separate Sandbox environment with its own credentials, dashboards, and datasets that mirrors live features/APIs without touching production data, including a sandbox-specific MCP endpoint (sandbox-mcp.paddle.com) and a dedicated 'paddle-sandbox-testing' agent skill discoverable via the well-known skills index — directly supporting AI-native testing workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that AI agents actually complete sandbox test flows successfully, and note that Paddle Retain (dunning) explicitly cannot be tested in sandbox, a documented limitation.
